notes.title: The Directorate - Intelligence Update #1
notes.content:
Gamescom
Put on your best spy suit and play The Directorate at Gamescom in Cologne this year! A public booth will be located in the Indie Area Hall 10.2. Come and meet the team, pick up some free swag and enter competitions!

Discord
Join us now on Discord to follow development in more detail and have your say on the direction the game will take. https://discord.com/invite/WbqZgFt5Gw


New Cinematic Trailer 
Take a look at the all-CGI trailer for The Directorate and get to know who’s who in the shadowy world of The Directorate.
